run_evaluate_program: run the evaluate function to score a program that solves the min max distance problem
test_evaluate_function: test the evaluate function by passing a path to a program module with min_max_dist_dim2_16
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that dynamically imports and scores candidate programs for the distance ratio problem
summarize_evaluate_function: summarize the evaluate function which computes the squared inverse ratio of min to max pairwise distances
refactor_evaluate_function: refactor the evaluate function to support configurable number of points and dimensions instead of hardcoded values
